crossings.note: OSM ways with bridge / tunnel / covered that cross the game centreline (layer > 0: over the track, the car passes under; layer < 0: under the track)

findings.game: lengthKm 4.325 (the dataset's 4.322 km: the geometry, 4.286 km true, is scaled up by 0.9 %).
findings.real: Official 4.259 km (No. 6 with Senna S); the OSM racing line of the same layout measures 4.278 km. The game lap is 1.5 % longer than the official one, every corner 0.9 % larger than the real road.
findings.proposedFix: Official length override 4259 m for ar-1952 in build-tracks (the rescale then shrinks the geometry by 0.6 % instead of enlarging it by 0.9 %), or no rescale at all for this circuit (proposedCorrections.officialLengthM).

findings.game: track.pit: right side (-1), 80 km/h, lane from s 4075 to s 250 (entry line s 4161, exit line s 164).
findings.real: Right side: the OSM "Boxes" way (645 m) leaves the track at s 3864 (461 m before points[0]) and rejoins at s 209. (No F1 limit figure found for 1995-1998; 80 km/h kept.)
OSM node 9311100671 raceway=start-finish lies 68.2 m before it (0.4 m off the centreline).

findings.proposedFix: None in the data; if real-banking corners should stand out more (the Zandvoort / Madring complaint), consider lowering BANK_MAX for curvature-derived banking so that unbanked hairpins do not look banked.
findings.game: Curvature-derived banking up to 5.7 deg; every corner tighter than ~35 m gets 4.5-5.9 deg (s 334 Numero Uno R 27 m: 5.4 deg; s 780 Confitería R 29.7 m: 5.1 deg; s 2331 Entrata a los Mixtos R 26.8 m: 5.5 deg; s 2549 Viborita R 33.7 m: 4.6 deg; s 3165 S de Senna R 19 m: 5.7 deg; s 3247 S de Senna R 15.9 m: 5.7 deg; ...). No bankOverrides.
findings.real: No banked corner is documented for this circuit (Wikipedia en / pt / es, official site); OSM ways carry no banking / incline tags.

officialLengthM.why: dataset length 4322 is not the official No. 6 + Senna S length
